title: 样板词库 (Sample Vocabulary)
description: 1 个单元 · 3 个示例词汇（可替换为 wordbooks/ 中的词库或自制词库）

words.rootIntro: BENE comes from the Latin for well. A benefit is a good result or effect; something beneficial produces good results.
words.enMeaning: A prayer that asks for God's blessing, especially a prayer that concludes a worship service.
words.contextExplanation: 由词根 bene（好、善）与 dict（说）组合，字面意思是“说好话”，引申为宗教仪式末尾或临别时的祝福祈祷。

examples.en: The bishop pronounced the benediction at the end of the service.
examples.zh: 主教在礼拜结束时作了祝福祈祷。

words.rootBreakdown: bene-（好、善） + dict（说、讲） + -ion（名词后缀，表行为） → 祝福
words.etymology: 源自拉丁语 benedictio（bene“好” + dicere“说”），原指祝福或祝颂。

words.rootIntro: BENE comes from the Latin for well. A benefit is a good result or effect; something beneficial produces good results.
words.enMeaning: Someone who helps another person or group, especially by giving money.
words.contextExplanation: bene（好）加上 fact（做），即“做好事的人”，通常指资助学校、医院或个人发展的捐助者。

examples.en: An anonymous benefactor donated funds to build the new library.
examples.zh: 一位匿名捐助者出资修建了新图书馆。

words.rootBreakdown: bene-（好、善） + fact（做、制造） + -or（名词后缀，表人） → 捐助者
words.etymology: 源自拉丁语 benefactor（bene“好” + facere“做”），意为施惠者、资助人。

words.rootIntro: AM comes from the Latin amare, to love. Amiable means friendly or good-natured.
words.enMeaning: Characterized by friendliness and absence of discord.
words.contextExplanation: 常用来形容谈判、协议或双方在分歧之后保持克制与友善的关系，如 an amicable settlement。

examples.en: They reached an amicable agreement after hours of discussion.
examples.zh: 经过数小时讨论，他们达成了友好协议。

words.rootBreakdown: am-（爱、友好） + -ic + -able（形容词后缀） → 友好的
words.etymology: 源自拉丁语 amicabilis，由 amicus（朋友）演变而来。
